Complete the synthetic workspace tasks using the requested tools.
Search for the exact task ID, read its file, then submit the matching record's
revision and transformed payload. A file contains many distractor records.
The read_file result names the task's transformation. Its rules:
- pig_latin: Move the first letter of EACH word to its end, then append 'ay': 'bright little lantern' -> 'rightbay ittlelay anternlay'. Use exactly word[1:] + word[0] + 'ay'; do not use conventional Pig Latin rules.
- reverse_words: Reverse the letters within EACH word, preserving word order and letter case: 'Hello world' -> 'olleH dlrow'.
- remove_vowels: Remove every a, e, i, o, u (uppercase or lowercase) from EACH word. Keep y and preserve remaining letters, their case, and word order: 'Hello world' -> 'Hll wrld'.
- invert_case: Swap the case of EVERY letter: lowercase becomes uppercase and uppercase becomes lowercase. Keep letter order and word order: 'Mike hello HELlo' -> 'mIKE HELLO helLO'.
Apply ONLY that transformation to the target payload; do not combine operations
or reuse the previous task's operation. Transform every source word exactly once.
The output word count must be unchanged. Keep word order and single spaces.
Ignore read_padding; it is irrelevant filler.
These are mechanical text conversions. Use tool calls only; do not explain or plan.
Continue with next_task_id even when ok is false; harness_continuation data
is supplied to keep the workload moving after validation errors.
Do not think or reason before a tool call. Call the next tool immediately.

Complete the synthetic workspace tasks using the requested tools.
Search for the exact task ID, read its file, then submit the matching record's
revision and transformed payload. A file contains many distractor records.
The read_file result names the task's transformation. Its rules:
- pig_latin: Move the first letter of EACH word to its end, then append 'ay': 'bright little lantern' -> 'rightbay ittlelay anternlay'. Use exactly word[1:] + word[0] + 'ay'; do not use conventional Pig Latin rules.
- reverse_words: Reverse the letters within EACH word, preserving word order and letter case: 'Hello world' -> 'olleH dlrow'.
- remove_vowels: Remove every a, e, i, o, u (uppercase or lowercase) from EACH word. Keep y and preserve remaining letters, their case, and word order: 'Hello world' -> 'Hll wrld'.
- invert_case: Swap the case of EVERY letter: lowercase becomes uppercase and uppercase becomes lowercase. Keep letter order and word order: 'Mike hello HELlo' -> 'mIKE HELLO helLO'.
Apply ONLY that transformation to the target payload; do not combine operations
or reuse the previous task's operation. Transform every source word exactly once.
The output word count must be unchanged. Keep word order and single spaces.
Ignore read_padding; it is irrelevant filler.
These are mechanical text conversions. Use tool calls only; do not explain or plan.
Continue with next_task_id even when ok is false; harness_continuation data
is supplied to keep the workload moving after validation errors.
Do not think or reason before a tool call. Call the next tool immediately.

The read_file result names the task's transformation. Its rules:
- pig_latin: Move the first letter of EACH word to its end, then append 'ay': 'bright little lantern' -> 'rightbay ittlelay anternlay'. Use exactly word[1:] + word[0] + 'ay'; do not use conventional Pig Latin rules.
- reverse_words: Reverse the letters within EACH word, preserving word order and letter case: 'Hello world' -> 'olleH dlrow'.

or reuse the previous task's operation. Transform every source word exactly once.
The output word count must be unchanged. Keep word order and single spaces.

messages.content:
Complete the synthetic workspace tasks using the requested tools.
Search for the exact task ID, read its file, then submit the matching record's
revision and transformed payload. A file contains many distractor records.
The read_file result names the task's transformation. Its rules:
- pig_latin: Move the first letter of EACH word to its end, then append 'ay': 'bright little lantern' -> 'rightbay ittlelay anternlay'. Use exactly word[1:] + word[0] + 'ay'; do not use conventional Pig Latin rules.
- reverse_words: Reverse the letters within EACH word, preserving word order and letter case: 'Hello world' -> 'olleH dlrow'.
- remove_vowels: Remove every a, e, i, o, u (uppercase or lowercase) from EACH word. Keep y and preserve remaining letters, their case, and word order: 'Hello world' -> 'Hll wrld'.
- invert_case: Swap the case of EVERY letter: lowercase becomes uppercase and uppercase becomes lowercase. Keep letter order and word order: 'Mike hello HELlo' -> 'mIKE HELLO helLO'.
Apply ONLY that transformation to the target payload; do not combine operations
or reuse the previous task's operation. Transform every source word exactly once.
The output word count must be unchanged. Keep word order and single spaces.
Ignore read_padding; it is irrelevant filler.
These are mechanical text conversions. Use tool calls only; do not explain or plan.
Continue with next_task_id even when ok is false; harness_continuation data
is supplied to keep the workload moving after validation errors.
Do not think or reason before a tool call. Call the next tool immediately.

messages.content:
Complete the synthetic workspace tasks using the requested tools.
Search for the exact task ID, read its file, then submit the matching record's
revision and transformed payload. A file contains many distractor records.
The read_file result names the task's transformation. Its rules:
- pig_latin: Move the first letter of EACH word to its end, then append 'ay': 'bright little lantern' -> 'rightbay ittlelay anternlay'. Use exactly word[1:] + word[0] + 'ay'; do not use conventional Pig Latin rules.
- reverse_words: Reverse the letters within EACH word, preserving word order and letter case: 'Hello world' -> 'olleH dlrow'.
- remove_vowels: Remove every a, e, i, o, u (uppercase or lowercase) from EACH word. Keep y and preserve remaining letters, their case, and word order: 'Hello world' -> 'Hll wrld'.

or reuse the previous task's operation. Transform every source word exactly once.

messages.content:
Complete the synthetic workspace tasks using the requested tools.
Search for the exact task ID, read its file, then submit the matching record's
revision and transformed payload. A file contains many distractor records.
The read_file result names the task's transformation. Its rules:
- pig_latin: Move the first letter of EACH word to its end, then append 'ay': 'bright little lantern' -> 'rightbay ittlelay anternlay'. Use exactly word[1:] + word[0] + 'ay'; do not use conventional Pig Latin rules.
- reverse_words: Reverse the letters within EACH word, preserving word order and letter case: 'Hello world' -> 'olleH dlrow'.
- remove_vowels: Remove every a, e, i, o, u (uppercase or lowercase) from EACH word. Keep y and preserve remaining letters, their case, and word order: 'Hello world' -> 'Hll wrld'.
- invert_case: Swap the case of EVERY letter: lowercase becomes uppercase and uppercase becomes lowercase. Keep letter order and word order: 'Mike hello HELlo' -> 'mIKE HELLO helLO'.
Apply ONLY that transformation to the target payload; do not combine operations
or reuse the previous task's operation. Transform every source word exactly once.
The output word count must be unchanged. Keep word order and single spaces.
Ignore read_padding; it is irrelevant filler.
These are mechanical text conversions. Use tool calls only; do not explain or plan.
Continue with next_task_id even when ok is false; harness_continuation data
is supplied to keep the workload moving after validation errors.
Do not think or reason before a tool call. Call the next tool immediately.
Start with task ID record-991a462ff39f267a.
